newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BAe to give $50 mln orders to Belgian firms.
newsitem.headline: BAe to give $50 mln orders to Belgian firms.

text.p: British Aerospace has signed an agreement with Belgian airline Sabena to give Belgian companies $50 million (1.5 billion Belgian francs) worth of orders in the next ten years in compensation for Sabena's purchase of 23 aircraft from British Aerospace unit Avro last year, Sabena said on Friday.
Sabena technical director Peter De Smet told Reuters that one quarter of the orders would go to Sabena Technics, the rest to the Belgian aircraft industry.
"Belgian industry will have to be competitive, but the agreement contains penalty clauses in case British Aeropsace fails to live up to its commitment," he said.
He declined to detail the penalty clauses.
He said that Sabena did not get a commission on the orders passed on to the Belgian aircraft industry, but said that Sabena expected to get business from them in exchange.
